body: The darkness seemed to whisper secrets through the thick canvas of fabric that covered the window. I felt an inexplicable thrill as if time itself was rewinding for just this moment. My heart raced not from the rush of adrenaline but from the sheer beauty of uncharted territory inside those shadows.
